مُطَيَّرٌ A sort of [garment of the kind called] بُرْد (O, K) having upon it the forms of birds. (O.) ＝
-A2- And Aloes-wood: (K:) or a certain preparation thereof: (AHn, TA:) or such as is مُطَرًّى [i. e. mixed with some other odoriferous substance]; formed by transposition from the latter word; (O, K;) but this pleased not ISd: (TA:) or aloes-wood split and broken in pieces. (O, K. *)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
